column11: JUDGEMENT. NCT07830719 has an estimated primary completion of 2027-10-19; no Phase 3 is registered, and YMI024 is absent from Novartis's submission schedule (Q2 2026 investor presentation, p32). hsCRP and IL-6 are not approvable endpoints, so a label needs an outcomes trial. The closest analogue went from its Phase 2 primary completion to its outcomes trial start in 14.1 months: ziltivekimab's RESCUE (NCT03926117) completed 2020-06-26 and ZEUS (NCT05021835) started 2021-08-30, which puts a YMI024 Phase 3 start at about 2028-12. Kerendia, first approved on an event-driven cardiorenal outcomes trial, went from FIDELIO-DKD's start (NCT02540993, 2015-09-17) to approval on 2021-07-09 (NDA215341, openFDA), 5.81 years, which puts approval at about 2034-10 and makes 2035 the first full year
